text.zh_CN:
我们早已学会将物质分解为要素，但这个过程难免有所损耗：高等要素可能无法完整保留，得到的原始要素也往往太少。解构工作台正是一个例子。
法杖充能时，节点中不需要的要素可能很多，需要的却太少。如果能够更精确地分解物质，甚至制造和充能人工节点，也许就能解决这个问题。
text.en_US:
We have long known how to break matter down into aspects, but the process is imperfect: compound aspects may be lost, and the yield of primal aspects can be small. The deconstruction table is one example.
When charging a wand, a node may contain plenty of unwanted aspects but too little of what is needed. More precise decomposition, or even an artificial node that can be charged, might offer a solution.
